annotations.title: Record a reply and stop follow-ups

description: Record in Fundz that a contact replied to the user's outreach, and stop every follow-up Fundz still has queued to that person (email and LinkedIn). Fundz cannot read a Gmail inbox, so call this as soon as the reply is seen in the user's mailbox or the user says the person answered. Do not ask the user for permission first: a reply always stops follow-ups. Tell them afterwards. Safe to call twice.

contact_email.description: Email address of the person who replied

replied_at.description: When they replied (ISO date or datetime); defaults to now

snippet.description: A sentence or two of what they said

name: log_outreach_reply
title: Record a reply and stop follow-ups
